# Sweepr Cleaner

> Sweepr Cleaner is an ultra-lightweight, memory-safe desktop and mobile cleaner built in Rust and Tauri. It reclaims storage space, optimizes RAM & gaming performance, cleans browser & messenger caches, updates outdated software via Winget, and provides SSD-aware secure file shredding (1-pass zero-fill for SSDs and 3-pass overwrite for HDDs) with zero bloatware or background telemetry daemons.

## Architecture & Platform Support
- Desktop App: Built in Rust + Tauri (<15MB installer size). Supported on Windows 10, Windows 11, macOS, and Linux.
- Mobile App: Android & iOS companion cleaner with unified cross-platform licensing.
- Core Desktop Modules:
  - DeepClean: System temp, browser caches, Messenger & Collaboration caches (Slack, Teams, Zoom, Telegram, Discord), Windows Installer & INet cache slimmer, Activity & JumpList traces, and unified 7-day Quarantine + Recycle Bin inspector.
  - Optimization (RAM, Processes & Boot): Real-time RAM purge, interactive Process Manager (End Task), 1-click Gaming & Focus Boost, Startup Apps optimizer, Windows Right-Click Context Menu manager, and real Boot Time & Battery Health diagnostics.
  - Software & Shortcuts: Drag-and-Drop App Uninstaller with leftover file/registry scanner, Winget Software Updater, Registry Repair, and Broken Shortcuts (.lnk) & Empty Folder cleaner.
  - Storage & Duplicates: Cryptographic SHA-256 Duplicate Finder, Visual Disk Map, Large File Finder (>50MB), and 1-click Large File Mover across drives.
  - Privacy, Browser & Shredder: Browser Privacy Cleaner, Smart Cookie Allowlist, Browser SQLite Database VACUUM Compactor, Browser Extension Inspector, k-Anonymity Password Breach Check, Cryptographic Password Generator, and SSD-Aware Secure File Shredder (1-pass & 3-pass).
- Core Mobile Modules: Duplicate & Similar Photo Cleaner with Best Shot AI, Blurry Photo Detector, Swipe-to-Clean Photo Triage Mode, Hardware Video Compressor, Batch Photo Optimizer & EXIF GPS Location Privacy Stripper, WhatsApp & Telegram Media Cleaner, Safe Contact Merger & Old Calendar Events (>1 yr) Cleaner, 30-Day System Trash Undo, and Live Home-Screen Storage Widget.

## Pricing & Licensing
- Free Tier: Unlimited system & storage scanning and previewing.
- Annual Pro (Most Popular): £49.99/year (£4.16/mo equivalent — Save 58%, no free trial).
- 6-Month Pro: £38.99 every 6 months (£6.50/mo equivalent — Save 35%).
- Monthly Pro: £9.99/month (cancel anytime in 1 click).
- Pro Introductory Offer: £1.99 for the 1st month of full Pro access across 3 Desktop PCs + 2 Mobile devices, auto-renewing at £9.99/month.
- Guarantee: 14-day money-back guarantee.

## Key Differentiators vs Legacy Cleaners (CCleaner, Avast)
- No background adware or telemetry daemons.
- Under 15MB installer vs 100MB+ legacy bloatware.
- Memory-safe Rust engine for high-speed scanning and deletion.
- Exact file paths and byte sizes shown before anything is deleted, backed by a 7-day Quarantine rollback.
- Single license covers up to 3 Desktop PCs + 2 Mobile devices.
